title: Rioproperty full image
description: A single big photo in the page margins: 2:1 on desktop, a tall 5:6 on phones. It enters a quarter too big, spilling past the margins, and settles into place as it comes fully into view, while the photo drifts slowly inside its square-cornered frame.
notes: the media slot fills the frame like object-fit cover and is 40% taller than it for the drift; empty, it is a bg-muted placeholder
name: rioproperty-full-image

props.name: media
props.description:
a photo or video; fills the frame like object-fit cover and drifts inside it. Empty: a
placeholder

props.name: label
props.description: a text alternative for the frame, read when the media is decorative
